topic: Male anglerfish fuse to females for life
script: Some male anglerfish fuse their bodies to a female and never let go. In these deep sea species, the males are tiny compared to the females. A male bites onto her, and their skin and blood vessels slowly join together. He then lives off her blood, while his eyes and many organs waste away. One female can carry several of these attached males at once. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
title: Male Anglerfish Fuse to Females Forever #DeepSea #Anglerfish #Shorts
description:
